name: Docker
description: Your Docker containers in a card: grouped by compose project, with state, health, ports, uptime, CPU and memory; start, stop, restart, remove, logs and details, a whole project at once; images (remove, clean up dangling ones), volumes and disk use. A card per container; linked terminals start, stop, read logs and run commands. Uses the docker command of the computer (Docker Desktop or any engine docker reaches); downloads nothing. Not made or endorsed by Docker, Inc.
